Repairs and warranty

Warranty

Full gauge systems (part numbers starting STR, VFD, RET, VHX, HDX, RTX and GRFX) are typically covered by a lifetime warranty, for the life of the vehicle, against manufacturer's defects. Individual automotive gauges and all motorcycle products are typically covered for 24 months from purchase.

Sending a unit in

Contact us for an RMA number first. Then send the complete unit with your name, address, phone number and a description of the problem to: Dakota Digital Inc., Attn: Repair Dept., 4510 W. 61st St North, Sioux Falls SD 57107.

Repair cost

Warranty repairs are free. Typical non-warranty repairs start at $65, depending on the product and the problem.
